# Split sdk-api.md into focused sub-pages

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary
- Split the ~500-line `sdk-api.md` into 4 focused pages for easier navigation
- `sdk-api.md` retains entry points, calling convention, types table, and test utils
- New `sdk-api/utilities.md`: Logger, LogMsg, ByteBuf, Decoder, byte types
- New `sdk-api/data-access.md`: Fetchers, Service Data, Preimages, Context Wrappers
- New `sdk-api/ecalli.md`: host call reference tables and error sentinels

## Test plan
- [x] `mdbook build docs` succeeds
- [x] No content lost — all sections preserved across the split
- [x] Pre-push hooks pass (QA + build)
